ExpiryDateTime.name: Expiry Date Time
ExpiryDateTime.definition: Date and time when the expiry of the undertaking takes effect.

ExpiryCondition.name: Expiry Condition
ExpiryCondition.definition: Condition that indicates when the undertaking will cease to be available at the place for presentation.

OpenEndedIndicator.name: Open Ended Indicator
OpenEndedIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the expiry period is open ended.

Undertaking.name: Undertaking
Undertaking.definition: Undertaking for which expiry information is specified.

ExpiryPlace.name: Expiry Place
ExpiryPlace.definition: Place where the expiry of the undertaking takes effect.
